title: Left4Craft
description: A small community Minecraft server with survival, creative, and more.
body:
Left4Craft is a small server with a friendly community and over 12 years of history. Our primary gamemode is semi-vanilla Survival with [rules](https://l4c.link/rules) and mechanisms to make other players friends, not threats.

Hundreds of players — young and old — have been part of our international community, many have fond memories, and some of our original players are still active.

With the low cost of budget Minecraft hosting, it is easy for anyone who has no idea what they are doing to start a Minecraft server. Here are some of the things that make Left4Craft better than most:

- Competent staff with years of experience
- We are professional developers; we create custom plugins and systems for the best quality
- Hosted on dedicated and specialised hardware
- Lag-free with a consistent 20 TPS, verifiable with data on our public [status page](https://status.left4craft.org/)
- Premium enterprise networking ensures low latency for players across North America and most of Europe
- Each gamemode is on a separate server (with a custom plugin for cross-server chat) – you can keep playing even if one server is down for maintenance
- Donators are given fair and mostly cosmetic rewards

## Gamemodes

[![Gamemode: Survival](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d823c2dcad93ab3df3cc75e401c2dcc54660bc92.webp)](https://modrinth.com/server/left4craft/gallery)

### Grief-free semi-vanilla Survival

- Vanilla enhancements, including an economy, teleportation, tree-felling assistance, majority sleep, and fun cosmetics 
- Protect your builds, animals, and items from destruction and theft with [land claims](https://wiki.left4craft.org/claims/)
- Even unclaimed land is safe, as griefing/raiding is not allowed and can be rolled back with precision by staff
- You won't be randomly murdered because PvP requires consent
- Trade with protection against scamming
- The world is reset for some updates, but we make [old worlds available for download](https://wiki.left4craft.org/old-worlds/)

---

[![Gamemode: Creative](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/249c3b78e6a0f85f642802173b8607900d7d9231.webp)](https://modrinth.com/server/left4craft/gallery)

### Creative with WorldEdit

- Large 101² plots
- Free (limited) world edit for all players
- Get a second plot by joining us on [Discord](https://l4c.link/discord)
- [Donators can get more plots and unlimited WorldEdit](https://www.left4craft.org/shop)
- Adjacent plots can be joined to create superplots
- Collaborate with trusted players
- Thousands of striking builds to explore, some over a decade old

---

[![Gamemode: Party Games](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a8e945c945bbe8ba00fb0fd08ab1693a5e0706b.webp)](https://modrinth.com/server/left4craft/gallery)

### Party Games

- Over a dozen custom games with unique maps
- Playable with as few as 4 players
- Earn points and climb the leaderboards
